bundle.shortDescription: Field guide to the threatened plants of the Western Ghats
bundle.longDescription: Version 2 – Updated of the RET Kit, A Field Guide to Threatened Plants of Western Ghats (Prof. K.N. Ganeshaiah, UAS Bangalore, 2015-2016): identify 178 threatened plants (101 original and 77 added in 2026) from their characters, with current names (Catalogue of Life) and conservation status (IUCN, BSI, FRLHT/TDU), species sheets and credited photos.
